card.name: The word of after a noun
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a noun like period, branch, arm, zone or moments, where a noun phrase continues. Often seen in "over a period of" in dosing text.

modes.label: Period of
modes.description: "of" after "period" in infusion or duration phrases.
modes.example: The total daily dose should be infused over a period<< of>> 8 to 12 hours.

modes.label: Other nouns plus of
modes.description: "of" after nouns such as branch, arm, zone or moments in general prose.
modes.example: although mostly as a branch<< of>> feminist disciplines.
